# Debug Protocol V1

Payload types of the Grimoire debug protocol v1 (engine contract §13).

Format version **1**.

This page is generated from `schema/debug_protocol_v1.gschema` by `grimoire_schemagen` (project ADR-0011); the
generated Rust types live next to the crate that owns this format. Frame/pack framing
logic (length prefixes, header, handshake) is documented in the engine contract
(`docs/architektur/crate-vertraege.md`), not repeated here.

## Message catalogue

| ID | Message | Direction | Payload | Description |
|----|---------|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `0x0001` | `Hello` | T↔E | [`Hello`](#hello) | Handshake request/response. |
| `0x0002` | `Error` | T↔E | [`ErrorMsg`](#errormsg) | Protocol- or application-level error. |
| `0x0003` | `Log` | E→T | [`LogMsg`](#logmsg) | One forwarded engine log line. |
| `0x0010` | `Stats` | E→T | [`Stats`](#stats) | Per-frame profiler snapshot. |
| `0x0020` | `SwapSigilUnit` | T→E | [`SwapSigilUnit`](#swapsigilunit) | Hot-swap request. |
| `0x0021` | `SwapAck` | E→T | [`SwapAck`](#swapack) | Hot-swap acknowledgement. |
| `0x0022` | `SigilPreview` | T→E | [`SigilPreview`](#sigilpreview) | Offline preview request (`NotSupported` in v1). |

## `PeerRole` (enum, u8)

Which side of a debug-link connection a peer is (contract §13 `Hello.role`).

| Value | Variant | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| 0 | `Tool` | Tool-side peer: editor, CLI (`grimoire-link`), or a future C# client. |
| 1 | `Engine` | Engine-side peer: the running Grimoire engine. |

## `ErrorCode` (enum, u16)

Machine-readable reason attached to an `Error` message (contract §13).
`#[non_exhaustive]`: new codes are additive (contract §2 rule 13). A code this build does not
recognise (e.g. sent by a newer protocol version) decodes as `Malformed` rather than failing
outright, because `Error`'s id and layout are frozen across every protocol version.

Growable (`#[non_exhaustive]`); an unrecognised wire value decodes as `Malformed`.

| Value | Variant | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| 1 | `HandshakeRequired` | The first frame of a connection was not a valid `Hello`. |
| 2 | `VersionMismatch` | `protocol_version`, `engine_version` or `build_hash` did not match. |
| 3 | `Unauthorized` | The `Hello` token did not match. |
| 4 | `Malformed` | A frame's payload failed to decode even though its length was valid. |
| 5 | `UnknownMessage` | The message id is not in the v1 catalogue and not reserved. |
| 6 | `TooLarge` | A frame (or the pre-handshake first frame) exceeded its length limit. |
| 7 | `NotSupported` | The message id is reserved, or its direction does not match the sender. |
| 8 | `Busy` | A second client tried to connect while one was already connected. |
| 9 | `Internal` | An internal error on the responding side prevented handling the message. |

## `Hello` (struct)

Handshake request/response (contract §13, message id `0x0001`, `T↔E`).
Frozen across all protocol versions: this id, and `protocol_version` as its first field.

| Field | Wire type | Description |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| `protocol_version` | u16 | Protocol version the sender speaks; always this struct's first field. |
| `role` | [`PeerRole`](#peerrole) | Tool or Engine. |
| `engine_version` | Str≤64 | The sender's `ENGINE_VERSION` (contract §8.1). |
| `build_hash` | Str≤64 | The sender's `BuildHash::to_hex()`, or the literal `unknown`. |
| `token` | [u8; 32] | Debug-link token; all zero when sent by the engine. |
| `stats_interval_frames` | u16 | `Stats` cadence in frames the tool requests; `0` = no `Stats`. |

## `ErrorMsg` (struct)

Reports a protocol- or application-level error (contract §13, message id `0x0002`, `T↔E`).
Frozen across all protocol versions: this id, and this struct's layout.

| Field | Wire type | Description |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| `code` | [`ErrorCode`](#errorcode) | Machine-readable reason. |
| `in_reply_to` | u32 | `seq` of the frame this responds to, or `0` if unsolicited. |
| `message` | Str≤1024 | Human-readable detail, not meant to be matched on. |

## `LogMsg` (struct)

One engine log line, forwarded over the debug link (contract §13, message id `0x0003`, `E→T`).

| Field | Wire type | Description |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| `level` | u8 | Log level: `1` error, `2` warn, `3` info, `4` debug, `5` trace. |
| `tick` | u64 | Simulation tick the log line was emitted on. |
| `target` | Str≤128 | Log target (module path or subsystem name). |
| `text` | Str≤4096 | The log message. |

## `StatsScope` (struct)

One profiler scope's totals for one frame (row type of `Stats.scopes`).
`#[non_exhaustive]` with `Default`: the facade builds it outside `grimoire_debug`
(contract §2 rule 13).

Growable (`#[non_exhaustive]`, built via `Default` and field assignment).

| Field | Wire type | Description |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| `scope` | u16 | `ScopeId` the totals belong to. |
| `name` | Str≤64 | Scope name, as first recorded this frame; may be truncated at a char boundary. |
| `total_ns` | u64 | Accumulated duration in nanoseconds; `u64::MAX` on overflow, never a panic. |
| `calls` | u32 | Number of times this scope was recorded this frame. |
| `budget_ns` | u64 | Budget in nanoseconds, or `0` for none. |
| `estimate` | bool | `true` marks a fallback value taken without a real measurement. |

## `StatsCounter` (struct)

One named counter's value for one frame (row type of `Stats.counters`).

| Field | Wire type | Description |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| `name` | Str≤64 | Counter name. |
| `value` | u64 | Counter value. |

## `Stats` (struct)

Per-frame profiler snapshot (contract §13, message id `0x0010`, `E→T`).
`#[non_exhaustive]` with `Default`: the facade builds it outside `grimoire_debug`, and it
grows fields with Plan-0002 WP6.3 (contract §2 rule 13).

Growable (`#[non_exhaustive]`, built via `Default` and field assignment).

| Field | Wire type | Description |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| `frame` | u64 | Frame counter. |
| `sim_tick` | u64 | Simulation tick counter. |
| `ticks_this_frame` | u32 | Number of simulation ticks run this frame. |
| `alpha` | f32 | Interpolation factor between the last two ticks. |
| `frame_time_ns` | u64 | Frame duration in nanoseconds; `u64::MAX` on overflow. |
| `fps` | f32 | Frames per second, as `f32` (contract §13; the facade's own value is `f64`). |
| `dropped_time_ns` | u64 | Time dropped by the fixed-timestep clamp, in nanoseconds. |
| `content_swaps` | u32 | Number of Sigil unit swaps applied so far. |
| `content_manifest` | u64 | Content epoch (contract §11.8), i.e. the current content-manifest hash. |
| `scopes` | Vec≤64<[`StatsScope`](#statsscope)> | Profiler scopes, in first-recorded order; at most 64, truncated deterministically. |
| `counters` | Vec≤64<[`StatsCounter`](#statscounter)> | Named counters, in first-recorded order; at most 64, truncated deterministically. |

## `SwapSigilUnit` (struct)

Requests a hot-swap of one Sigil unit (contract §13, message id `0x0020`, `T→E`).

| Field | Wire type | Description |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| `unit_path` | Str≤255 | `AssetPath` of the unit to swap in. |
| `unit_bytes` | Bytes≤8388608 | Binary `SigilUnit` bytes (contract §11.1); at most `MAX_UNIT_BYTES`. |

## `SwapAck` (struct)

Acknowledges a `SwapSigilUnit` request (contract §13, message id `0x0021`, `E→T`).
`#[non_exhaustive]` with `Default`: the facade builds it outside `grimoire_debug`
(contract §2 rule 13).

Growable (`#[non_exhaustive]`, built via `Default` and field assignment).

| Field | Wire type | Description |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| `in_reply_to` | u32 | `seq` of the triggering `SwapSigilUnit` frame. |
| `status` | u8 | `0` applied, `1` rejected, `2` superseded by a later swap of the same unit. |
| `applied_tick` | u64 | First tick that ran with the new unit; `0` if not applied. |
| `content_swaps` | u32 | Number of Sigil unit swaps applied so far (after this one, if applied). |
| `content_manifest` | u64 | Content epoch after this swap (contract §11.8). |
| `unit_hash` | u64 | The swapped unit's `SigilUnit::content_hash`. |
| `reason` | Str≤1024 | Human-readable detail when `status != 0`. |

## `SigilPreview` (struct)

Requests an offline preview run of a Sigil unit (contract §13, message id `0x0022`, `T→E`).
In protocol v1 the engine always answers `Error(NotSupported)` (the editor preview uses
`sigilc simulate` instead, project ADR-0010); the payload is still defined so the codec and
its fixtures are complete for when a later version implements it.

| Field | Wire type | Description |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| `unit_path` | Str≤255 | `AssetPath` of the unit to preview. |
| `unit_bytes` | Bytes≤8388608 | Binary `SigilUnit` bytes; at most `MAX_UNIT_BYTES`. |
| `ticks` | u32 | Number of ticks to simulate. |
| `target` | Option<[f32; 2]> | Optional aim-target position sampled during the preview. |
